baseline_models.mechanism: The day is both a severe occurrence and a reality fixed against falsehood; the obligation branch of haqq adds that it is due, not merely accurately described.

activation_trace.role: The image of a grave event makes the day an occurrence that bears down, not a neutral calendar unit.
Stable correspondence with reality gives the event its non-negotiable actuality.
The image of something binding and due turns actuality into an approaching claim.

changed_reading.before: That is simply the true day.
changed_reading.after: That grave event is the fixed reality whose arrival is due and binding.

baseline_models.mechanism: Mere preference becomes an enacted sequence: willing attaches to an object, taking makes it one's acquisition, and ma'ab supplies a return and its place. The route is deliberately appropriated rather than passively awaited.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward a thing supplies the initiating intention.
Making or acquiring something for oneself turns intention into durable appropriation.
Return together with its return-place gives the acquired object both movement and destination.

changed_reading.before: Anyone who wishes may return to the Lord.
changed_reading.after: Anyone who wills must make the Lordward return into something actually taken up as one's own route.

baseline_models.mechanism: The endpoint is named through lordship as repair, nurture, and completion, while awb can picture recurrent motion. Ma'ab can therefore be an ongoing homeward orientation toward the one who brings a life to completion, as well as a terminal destination.

activation_trace.role: Progressive nurture and completion characterize the Lordward endpoint as formative.
Repeated movement of limbs in travel supplies a practiced rather than instantaneous return.

changed_reading.before: Ma'ab is only the place reached at the end.
changed_reading.after: Ma'ab can also be the repeated homeward motion by which the Lord's nurture reaches completion.

baseline_models.mechanism: A specific right or share can be coupled with taking possession and with awb's side or direction. The invitation can be heard as taking one's due return-side, while the explicit 'toward his Lord' prevents that claim from becoming self-grounded entitlement.

activation_trace.role: A right belonging to its holder supplies the image of a personally available share.
Taking and bringing into one's possession turns the available share into an acted claim.
A side from which one comes spatializes the claimed share as a direction of return.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers an unspecified way back.
changed_reading.after: The verse may offer a return-side that a person can claim only by directing the claim toward the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah moves from mutual questioning and divergent paths to repeated promised knowing. Against that arc, 'the true day' is not only true information; it is the event that discloses what disagreement could not settle.

activation_trace.role: Showing and establishing truth anchors the focus phrase as public disclosure.
Mutual questioning supplies the opening state of unresolved reciprocal inquiry.
People taking different paths makes the dispute a divergence that requires resolution.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the promised transition from dispute to manifest knowledge.

structural_cues: The opening question and disagreement are followed by the doubled warning 'they will know.'
The focus demonstrative 'that' points back across the described event sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inquiry, divergence, repeated knowing, and a true day; I infer that the event itself adjudicates by disclosure. A live alternative is that the knowing is only punitive warning and does not define haqq.

changed_reading.before: The day is a proposition that happens to be true.
changed_reading.after: The day is truth becoming manifest and ending the community's divergent questioning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated divine making establishes a furnished order of ground, rest, alternation, and growth. Human ittikhadh in the focus is then responsive agency inside that made order: one takes a route using conditions already made and sustained by the Lord.

activation_trace.role: Acquiring something for oneself anchors the distinct human act of taking up the route.
Nurture and completion identify the maker's order as sustaining rather than merely prior.
Putting something into a usable condition begins the repeated pattern of divinely furnished conditions.
Rest and stillness make ordinary interruption part of the sustaining order.
Delivery downward supplies a prior gift that human action does not originate.
Growth emerging from earth shows made conditions issuing in life and provision.

structural_cues: The repeated 'We made' sequence precedes the focus's singular human 'takes.'
Ground, sleep, night, day, rain, grain, and gardens form an enabling chain rather than an inventory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine making, rest, descent, growth, and human taking; I infer that the former enables rather than cancels the latter. The alternative is that the creation list serves only as proof and does not qualify the grammar of choice.

changed_reading.before: The person independently constructs a path to the Lord.
changed_reading.after: The person actively takes up a Lordward path within conditions the Lord has already made, rested, watered, and brought to growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Separation between outcomes, recompense fitted to action, exhaustive enumeration, and inscription turn haqq into exact operative fit. The day is the junction at which deeds and consequences are separated and then joined without remainder.

activation_trace.role: The image of a right part matching its joint or receptacle anchors exact fit in the focus word.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the decisive sorting operation.
Mutual fit makes recompense correspond to what generated it.
Exhaustive counting blocks any residue from escaping the fit.
Inscription that establishes a binding judgment stabilizes the counted correspondence.

structural_cues: The appointed day divides into extended punishment and protected attainment.
The accounting vocabulary stands between the two outcome blocks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation, fitted recompense, exhaustive count, and binding record; I infer a causal system matching deeds to outcomes. The alternative is that these are separate forensic images rather than one mechanism of haqq.

changed_reading.before: Haqq means only that the day certainly exists.
changed_reading.after: Haqq also names the day's exact operation: it separates paths and fits each recorded deed to its consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier punishment block gives boundary-crossers a return-place, while the later block gives the guarded an attainment. Ma'ab is therefore not automatically favorable; the focus's direction 'toward his Lord' and the act of taking that direction distinguish the desired return.

activation_trace.role: A return-place anchors the shared but morally underdetermined destination image.
Deliberate acquisition makes direction something a person must take up before arrival.
Crossing the limit supplies the conduct attached to the adverse return-place.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the contrasting orientation of the guarded.
Attainment joined to rescue gives the protected direction its positive outcome.

structural_cues: The same surah assigns a ma'ab within the punishment block before the focus offers a ma'ab toward the Lord.
The two outcome blocks are marked by boundary-crossing and self-protection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an adverse return-place, a protected attainment, and the focus's explicit Lordward direction; I infer that return is neutral until its direction is specified. The alternative is that ma'ab is purely locative and the contrast concerns only its occupants.

changed_reading.before: Any return is implicitly a good homecoming.
changed_reading.after: Return alone does not save; the invited act is to take a specifically Lordward return rather than arrive at the return generated by transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus says the person wills and takes, but the nearby reward is a sufficient gift. Agency is neither autonomous production nor passive receipt: the person takes up what comes as provision from the Lord.

activation_trace.role: Directed willing preserves real personal initiative.
Taking into one's possession supplies the receptive action.
Lordship and ownership keep the route grounded in its giver rather than its taker.
Handing over a gift supplies the provision that precedes reception.
Sufficiency characterizes the gift as adequate without being manufactured by its recipient.

structural_cues: Gift and sufficiency appear immediately before the sovereignty and permission sequence that leads into the focus.
The focus keeps both a willing subject and a Lordward endpoint in one clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies giving, sufficiency, human willing, and taking; I infer that taking is reception made active. A live alternative is that the gift describes only the prior reward scene and does not constrain the focus invitation.

changed_reading.before: The willing person originates and owns the route by autonomous choice.
changed_reading.after: The willing person exercises receptive agency by taking up a sufficient Lord-given possibility of return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before 'whoever wills,' creatures do not own address, speech requires permission, and what is said must land rightly. The focus preserves choice but removes sovereign self-authorization: one can take a route, not command the court or define truth.

activation_trace.role: Volition anchors the genuine choice that the context then bounds.
Personal acquisition defines the allowed action as taking a route.
Ownership and power of disposal are explicitly absent from creaturely address.
Permission supplies the boundary within which speech can occur.
Right placement against error constrains permitted speech by truth.

structural_cues: The permission clause directly precedes the focus invitation without a scene break.
Speech ownership is denied while route-taking is offered, differentiating two kinds of agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied ownership, licensed speech, right speech, and then willing; I infer nested rather than absolute agency. The alternative is that permission governs only eschatological speech and has no bearing on the following choice formula.

changed_reading.after: Whoever wills has a real but bounded agency: the available act is to take the Lordward route within an order whose speech and truth one does not own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing warning makes the event near and depicts a person seeing what the hands advanced. This converts taking a ma'ab from a late verbal preference into present construction: deeds are sent ahead and become the route encountered on return.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition anchors route-making as something enacted before the destination is seen.
Return and return-place supply the later encounter toward which present acquisition moves.
A warning that awakens caution turns the focus invitation into advance notice for action.
Temporal nearness removes the option of indefinitely deferred route-taking.
Directed sight or insight supplies the final recognition of what was made.
Advancing something ahead gives present conduct a forward trajectory into the event.
What the hands earned identifies embodied deeds as the material advanced.

structural_cues: The focus invitation is immediately followed by warning, nearness, seeing, and deeds advanced.
The sequence shifts from present willing and taking to future inspection of prior action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies taking, return, warning, nearness, seeing, and hand-deeds sent ahead; I infer that those deeds concretize the route being taken. The alternative is that the deeds determine judgment but are not themselves the ma'ab.

changed_reading.before: A person can choose the return-path as a final inward preference.
changed_reading.after: A person takes the return-path now by sending embodied deeds ahead, then sees that constructed trajectory when the near event arrives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads final ma'ab through awb's evening and sunset branches; it remains anchored in the focus noun and is reinforced by the surah's night-rest alternation. Render it only as a temporal analogy or rehearsal, not as a replacement for eschatological return.

activation_trace.role: Coming at night supplies a recurring evening homecoming within the focus root.
The sun going to its return-place makes each sunset a bounded image of ma'ab.
Rest and stillness give nightly return a lived interruption of ordinary agency.
Night and darkness provide the repeated temporal chamber for that rehearsal.

changed_reading.before: Ma'ab occurs only once at the final event.
changed_reading.after: The nightly withdrawal of activity and the sun's recurring return can be carried as small rehearsals of the final Lordward ma'ab.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it activates akhadh's water-holding basin and a split nurture-growth mapping for rabb; it stays anchored in ittakhadha, rabbihi, and ma'ab while matching the packet's descent-to-growth chain. Downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for receptive agency, never as the direct lexical sense of the clause.

activation_trace.role: A basin that retains water recasts taking as forming a receptive holding-place.
The split root's nourishment and growth image makes the Lordward orientation productive rather than merely locative.
Return-place anchors the catchment image back in the focus destination.
Descent and settling supply what the imagined catchment receives.
Water provides the retained material in the analogy.
Plant emergence supplies the visible yield of receiving and retaining descent.

changed_reading.before: Taking a route means self-propelled movement toward a destination.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, taking a Lordward ma'ab can resemble making oneself a catchment: receiving what descends, retaining it, and returning it as nurtured growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is unusual because it combines taking on a manner with the repeated gait image of awb; both branches occur in focus roots, and the closing hand-deeds and forward advance make the bodily mechanism coherent. Qualify it as an enacted-habit reading, not a claim that ma'ab literally means gait.

activation_trace.role: Adopting a people's manner or gait makes taking a route a learned pattern of conduct.
The limbs' recurrent movement in travel gives the adopted pattern a bodily rhythm.
Forward advance projects the practiced pattern toward its later encounter.
What the hands earn grounds the gait metaphor in repeated embodied action.

changed_reading.before: The route is selected once as an abstract option.
changed_reading.after: The Lordward route can be carried as an acquired bodily gait: recurrent actions train the return one is already traveling.

strongest_changes: The true day becomes the event that discloses and resolves the opening disagreement, not merely a true proposition.
The punishment and attainment blocks make ma'ab directionally neutral until 'toward his Lord' qualifies the return.
Denied ownership and permitted right speech preserve willing as real but bounded agency.
The closing hand-deeds turn taking a return-path into present embodied construction rather than a last-minute preference.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah sequencing activated a tension unavailable to the focus alone: God repeatedly makes and gives, the person genuinely wills and takes, exact accounting fits action to outcome, and the final inspection reveals that the chosen return has already been embodied in deeds.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree to which creation's rest-and-growth cycle directly qualifies ma'ab, rather than serving as general proof, remains uncertain.
The specific-right reading of haqq and the catchment reading of ittakhadha are branch-grounded but deliberately exploratory.
The permission sequence may govern only speech at the event rather than the scope of willing in the next ayah.
